title: JP Morgan: demand for iPhone 18 Pro models is stronger than for the 17 Pro models last year
description: Analysts are sending mixed signals – sales of the iPhone 18 Pro models in China are stronger than those of the 17 Pro models and yet Apple is reportedly cutting component orders due to weak demand. The analysts at JP Morgan are saying that there’s nothing to worry about. In a note to investors, the analysts say that the production cut is a fairly typical adjustment for Apple after a big iPhone launch. They blame it on the split launch – Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in September and will launch the non-Pro models early next year. The note from JP Morgan confirms...

title: One UI 9 for the Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6 reaches the US
description: Last week, Samsung's One UI 9 rollout reached the Galaxy S24 series as well as the Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6, but, as usual, the company started it in South Korea. Now, a few days later, the update is also available in the US. Galaxy S24 devices purchased from both AT&T and T-Mobile are starting to receive the update in the US. The update comes over-the-air as an almost 4GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. Once you install it, you will be on One UI 9 based on Android 17, and you will also have the September 2026 security patch level. For the S24 models, the new...

title: Huawei may be launching a new phone sub-brand, here is what it will be called
description: When Huawei was put under trade restrictions by the US, it was no longer able to use Android for its phones – at least not the version offered by Google. Eventually, the company settled on a split strategy – Huawei proper would focus on its in-house HarmonyOS and Kirin chipsets while the Honor sub-brand would be spun off and continue with Android (and it retained access to Qualcomm and MediaTek chips). It seems like Huawei has been missing having a sub-brand – leakster Dingjiao Digital reported that Huawei will soon launch a sub-brand called Xingmang (星芒). This was later reprinted by...

title: iQOO Neo12's key specifications officially revealed
description: A recent rumor claimed that iQOO’s upcoming Neo12 would feature a 2K resolution display with a 185Hz refresh rate, supplied by Chinese manufacturer Visionox. Now, iQOO has officially confirmed the display specs and revealed a few more key details about the phone. The iQOO Neo12 is set to launch in China this month, although the company has yet to announce an exact date. Ahead of the launch, iQOO has confirmed that the phone will feature an OLED panel from Visionox. The display will offer a 2K resolution and 185Hz refresh rate. Visionox’s AMOLED panel uses p-TSF technology, which is...

title: OnePlus 16 arrives with SD 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 200MP camera and 9,000 mAh battery
description: The OnePlus 16 is now official, and it's shaping up to be one of the most interesting phones exclusive to China. It brings all of the upgrades you’d expect, including the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip, a 200MP main cam and a healthy battery upgrade. Starting from the top, the 16 is built around a 6.78-inch LTPO OLED with 1,272 x 2,772 px resolution and a 185Hz* refresh rate. Regarding the latter, the phone can run at 165Hz in everyday tasks while the extra 20Hz is “unlocked” in supported gaming titles. The panel features BOE’s X4 luminescent material and is capable of...

title: Nothing launches CMF Speakers S&M, here are the specs and pricing details
description: As expected from its teaser last week, Nothing's CMF has launched a couple of new products today. Meet the CMF Speakers S&M. These are the first portable speakers from CMF, and they both come with an "expressive geometric design", Bluetooth 6.0, IP68 dust and water resistance, as well as Stereo Mode and Party Mode for multi-speaker listening. Stereo Mode requires two identical speakers, while Party Mode is basically Auracast by a different name so it can work with two or more compatible speakers, including those from other brands. The smaller CMF Speaker S has a "custom-tuned" 45mm...

title: Report: there's a new iPad mini coming later this month and vanilla iPad coming next year
description: Apple is expected to unveil the HomeView hub for smart homes tomorrow. This event will likely feature additional products like smart locks and thermostats. Tomorrow’s event will be the first of two in October – the second is allegedly planned for later this month and will focus on new Macs and a new iPad mini. The latest iPad mini is from 2024 and it was a performance-oriented refresh of the 2021 model – it replaced the A15 chipset with an A17 Pro and doubled the RAM from 4GB to 8GB. The performance boost was appreciated and it enabled Apple Intelligence – well, it did in the regions where...

title: Another report suggests Samsung Galaxy S27 series could cost more
description: Earlier this month, a rumor suggested that Samsung’s upcoming Galaxy S27 series would be more expensive than the Galaxy S26 lineup. Now, another report has emerged supporting the possibility of a price hike. According to South Korean publication Chosun, Samsung is considering raising prices for the Galaxy S27 series between $75 to $100. The report attributes the potential increase to rising memory prices. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra However, the report does not clarify whether the proposed hike would be on top of the price increases Samsung introduced for the Galaxy S26 lineup earlier...

title: Apple HomeView coming tomorrow, more details emerge
description: We’re one day away from Apple’s smart-home focused product launch event and the latest PowerOn newsletter from Bloomberg’s Mike Gurman shines more light on what to expect. Apple’s long-awaited smart home control hub, which will allegedly be called HomeView, will come in two designs. The standard “countertop” model will feature a metal speaker base and four-color options - space gray, silver, starlight, and pink. Apple is also bringing a wall-mounted version, which will be available in space gray and silver. Concept renders, not leaked images Both HomeView models will feature the...

title: Honor Win 2 series with active cooling fan to be unveiled next week
description: Honor has confirmed that the successors to the Win and Win RT will be announced next week in China. The Win 2 series launch will also be accompanied by the Win Tablet and the Win Earbuds. The Honor Win 2 and Win 2 RT will be unveiled in China on October 21, the company confirmed via a post on Weibo. Honor has also offered a glimpse of the rear panel of the Win 2 series, which is expected to include the Win 2 and Win RT 2. The teaser image reveals a dual rear camera setup, an active cooling fan, the Win logo, and an LED light housed within a large camera island. An exhaust vent is...

title: vivo X Fold6 Nebula Teal hands-on
description: vivo launched the X Fold6 in China in June and announced it for international markets earlier this month. It also launched the X Fold6 in India a few days ago at the vivo NEXT 2026 event, where it unveiled the V80 and S2 FE and showcased the vivo Vision Discovery Edition MR headset. The vivo X Fold6 will be available in Prism Black and Nebula Teal in India. We already showed you the Prism Black model, so now let's take a look at the Nebula Teal colorway we've received. The retail package of our Indian Nebula Teal X Fold6 is identical to its global counterpart. The box has the same design...

title: Oppo F35 and F35 Pro debut, we handle the Find X10 series, Week 41 in review
description: Another week over, so let's do a recap. We unboxed the Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max - Oppo's latest Dimensity-equipped flagships. Both are still China-exclusive, but are going global on October 21. We also handled the freshly announced vivo V80. Our impressions span a few days with the phone, and we've added both performance tests and camera samples. Back to regular programming for a sec, vivo quietly unveiled the Y32 in Bangladesh. It packs a massive 8,000mAh battery with 44W charging. The rest of the specs are as follows: a 6.87-inch 120Hz LCD, a Unisoc T7300 chipset, a 50MP...

title: vivo X500E moves a step closer to launch as it gets Bluetooth certified
description: vivo unveiled the X300 E in July, and the X500E is expected to arrive as its successor in the next few months, with Bluetooth SIG certification bringing it closer to launch. The vivo X500E has been listed on the Bluetooth SIG website with model designation V2656, but the certifying authority hasn't revealed any other details about the smartphone. vivo X500E Bluetooth certified However, rumors claim the vivo X500E will come with the Dimensity 9500 SoC, a 6.59" display, a 50MP primary camera, a 64MP periscope telephoto camera, and a 7,500 mAh battery. vivo X300 E vivo's...

title: New insider tip claims the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will only be available with a Qualcomm chipset
description: This always seems to be a pressing question as pretty much every new Galaxy S family of devices is on the horizon – what chipsets will they use? We already know that the Exynos 2700 is, by early accounts, an excellent chip. The Exynos 2700 will be fabbed on Samsung’s SF2P, a second-generation 2nm Gate-All-Around (GAA) node. Compared to the first-gen node (SF2), which was used for the Exynos 2600, SF2P offers a 12% performance improvement, a 25% reduction in power usage and an 8% decrease in chip area. Plus, likely ARM C2 CPU cores. We also know that Samsung System LSI, which designed the...

title: The original Apple TV 4K from 2017 is now officially "vintage"
description: The smart streaming box/stick market is a bit weird for sure. There are all sorts of options out there, but each with distinct problems and limitations. Generic Android boxes are plentiful and can be powerful, but often offer a suboptimal software experience and format and technology support. There are cheap and easily available reputable options out there like Amazon's Firestick line, though that might be getting even more locked down with the move to Vega OS. Walmart has its "onn" line, but it is kind of US-only. Anyone actually serious about this device either swears by the Nvidia Shield...

title: Huawei Watch D3 in for review
description: Huawei's unique line of health-obsessed Watch D series' latest model is the Watch D3, and it's better in almost every way compared to its predecessor (review here). We'll get to that, but first, let's unbox it. You get a similar haul to the D2, but here too there are improvements. The magnetic wireless charging puck ends in a USB-C connection (finally), not USB-A like last year. You get an M-sized strap with a built-in airbag for blood pressure measurements, a wrist circumference ruler, and the watch itself. Huawei made some noticeable improvements to the Watch D2. The new model has...

title: Deals: Big discounts hit flagship phones from Samsung, Apple and Google
description: While Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days have wrapped up, discounts are still available on several smartphones. In fact, some devices that received few or no notable discounts during the sale are now available at reduced prices. Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra, Apple’s iPhone 17 Pro lineup, and the entire Google Pixel 11 series are among the phones on sale this weekend. The latest Samsung Galaxy Z foldables have also been discounted. The Galaxy S26 Ultra and the Galaxy S26+ are both available with good discounts. The Ultra receives up to £450 off, whereas the 512GB variant of the Galaxy S26+ is...

title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ or Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra?
description: Last year, the global tablet market was up 8.5% in Q1 as people started to replace devices they bought during the pandemic. Apple led the quarter with 13.7 million units shipped, up 14.0%, while Samsung was around half that with 6.6 million units shipped, down 5.2%. Samsung usually starts shipping its new flagship tablets in late Q3 (the Tab S11 models were available in September) or early Q4 (the Tab S12 series launched earlier this week), so shipments declining by 5.2% in Q1 was a bad look for the Tab S11 slates. So, now our attention turns to the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra – the Ultra...

title: The vivo X Fold6 powers advanced productivity features with India's biggest battery in a foldable
description: As folding technology matures, the focus has shifted from perfecting the hinge to slimming things down and now battery life has emerged as a key differentiating factor for foldables - the tablet-like multitasking, media consumption and gaming experience enabled by the larger screen put extra strain on the battery. The vivo X Fold6 is a productivity powerhouse with its large 8.02” main display, advanced multitasking, cross-platform features - plus India’s biggest battery in the foldable category, so that users can get an uncompromised smartphone experience. It has a 6,900mAh battery...

title: Weekly poll results: the vivo X Fold6 is hot, but its price can singe your wallet
description: As if foldables weren’t expensive enough, the skyrocketing costs of memory chips raised their prices even further – and that’s a problem for the vivo X Fold6. Not just for it, of course, the other foldables that it is competing with are in the same boat. Still, even among those who want a foldable phone, the largest contingent is people wishing for a price cut. In last week’s poll, we listed several price points for the X Fold6 from around Europe.
